name: RepresentationTheory.ZModInvolution.auxiliaryZModFinsets_partition
statement:
theorem auxiliaryZModFinsets_partition [NeZero (q ^ 2 - 1)] (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    Disjoint (auxiliaryZModFinsetB q) ((auxiliaryZModFinsetB q).image (zmodTransform q))
      ∧ (auxiliaryZModFinsetB q) ∪ (auxiliaryZModFinsetB q).image (zmodTransform q) = auxiliaryZModFinsetA q
      ∧ ((auxiliaryZModFinsetB q).image (zmodTransform q)).card = (auxiliaryZModFinsetB q).card

name: RepresentationTheory.ZModInvolution.card_auxiliaryZModFinsetA
statement: theorem card_auxiliaryZModFinsetA [NeZero (q ^ 2 - 1)] (hq : 2 ≤ q) : (auxiliaryZModFinsetA q).card = q * (q - 1)

name: RepresentationTheory.ZModInvolution.card_auxiliaryZModFinsetB
statement:
theorem card_auxiliaryZModFinsetB [NeZero (q ^ 2 - 1)] (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    (auxiliaryZModFinsetB q).card = q * (q - 1) / 2

name: RepresentationTheory.ZModInvolution.card_zmodTransform_fixedPoints
statement:
lemma card_zmodTransform_fixedPoints [NeZero (q ^ 2 - 1)] (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod (q ^ 2 - 1) => zmodTransform q x = x)).card = q - 1

name: RepresentationTheory.ZModInvolution.mem_auxiliaryZModFinsetA_iff
statement:
lemma mem_auxiliaryZModFinsetA_iff [NeZero (q ^ 2 - 1)] (x : ZMod (q ^ 2 - 1)) :
    x ∈ auxiliaryZModFinsetA q ↔ zmodTransform q x ≠ x

name: RepresentationTheory.ZModInvolution.zmodTransform_fixed_iff
statement:
lemma zmodTransform_fixed_iff (hq : 2 ≤ q) (x : ZMod (q ^ 2 - 1)) :
    zmodTransform q x = x ↔ (q + 1) ∣ x.val

name: RepresentationTheory.ZModInvolution.zmodTransform_involutive
statement: lemma zmodTransform_involutive (hq : 2 ≤ q) (x : ZMod (q ^ 2 - 1)) : zmodTransform q (zmodTransform q x) = x
